210	
211	Importantly, Section 2.2 of the Custody Agreement between Halcyon and Tidewater establishes Maryland as the securities intermediary\'s jurisdiction for purposes of UCC § 8-110(e). Under § 8-110(e), the local law of the securities intermediary\'s jurisdiction governs the perfection and priority of security interests in security entitlements. Consistency between the ACA and the Custody Agreement on this point is critical: if the ACA and the Custody Agreement designate different jurisdictions, the resulting conflict-of-law ambiguity could create uncertainty regarding the perfection and priority of the Secured Party\'s security interest --- the very issue the ACA is intended to resolve. Tidewater strongly believes that a unified jurisdictional designation across the Custody Agreement and the ACA is in the interest of all parties.
212	
213	As a matter of institutional practice, reflected in all of Tidewater\'s control agreements, Tidewater designates Maryland law and Maryland courts. Tidewater\'s in-house legal team, led by Mr. Norwood, and its primary regulatory counsel are based in Maryland and are best positioned to respond to litigation and regulatory matters in Maryland courts. Requiring Tidewater\'s personnel to litigate disputes in New York would impose unnecessary cost and operational disruption.
214	
215	**Flexibility Indication.** Tidewater considers Maryland governing law to be strongly preferred for the reasons stated above but acknowledges that the Secured Party may have reasons related to the Credit Agreement and the Pledge and Security Agreement --- both of which are presumably governed by New York law --- for preferring New York law to govern the ACA\'s contractual provisions. Tidewater is willing to discuss a compromise under which New York law governs the contractual provisions of the ACA (i.e., the rights and obligations of the parties as a matter of contract interpretation), while Maryland is designated as the securities intermediary\'s jurisdiction under UCC § 8-110(e) for purposes of determining the law governing the perfection and priority of security interests in the Account. Under such a framework, the Section 1.4 jurisdiction-selection provision would reference Maryland, ensuring that the perfection analysis is governed by Maryland law regardless of the choice of law applicable to the contract itself.
216	
217	The jurisdiction clause is more flexible. Tidewater could agree to non-exclusive jurisdiction (rather than exclusive jurisdiction in Maryland), or could consent to jurisdiction in both New York and Maryland, provided that the Maryland courts remain available as a forum in which Tidewater may bring or defend claims. Tidewater\'s primary concern is to ensure that it is not compelled to litigate exclusively in a jurisdiction where it has no office or personnel.
218	
219	**[IX. SECTION 14 --- REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES (Section 14.1(e))]{.underline}**
220	
221	**Summary of Changes**
222	
223	In **Section 14.1(e)**, Tidewater has deleted the representation that Tidewater has not entered into any other control agreement, entitlement order agreement, or similar agreement with any person (other than the Secured Party) with respect to the Account. The former subsections 14.1(f) and 14.1(g) have been renumbered as 14.1(e) and 14.1(f), respectively.
224	
225	**Tidewater\'s Rationale.** Tidewater cannot make an unqualified representation that no other control agreement exists with respect to the Account without conducting a comprehensive internal investigation across all of Tidewater\'s business lines, legacy systems, and archived documentation. While Tidewater is not aware, as of the date hereof, of any other control agreement currently in effect with respect to Securities Account No. 4491-7283-01, Tidewater\'s policy --- consistently applied across all control agreements --- is not to make unqualified representations of this nature. The risk of an inadvertent misrepresentation, based on incomplete information or a legacy arrangement that is not reflected in current records, is not a risk Tidewater is prepared to assume as a matter of representation.
226	
227	Moreover, the representation as drafted places ongoing compliance risk on Tidewater for matters that are more appropriately within the knowledge and control of the Pledgor. It is the Pledgor --- as the entitlement holder and as the party that controls the establishment of account relationships --- that is best positioned to know whether it has entered into any competing control or pledge arrangement with respect to the Account. The Pledgor\'s obligation to ensure the absence of competing control agreements is properly addressed in the Pledge and Security Agreement and in the representations and covenants of the Credit Agreement, not in a representation by the Securities Intermediary.
228	
229	Tidewater notes that the Pledgor\'s representations in Section 14.2 of the Orion Form, which Tidewater has not modified, include a representation regarding the absence of competing liens and encumbrances on the Account. That representation provides the Secured Party with appropriate assurance from the party that is in the best position to give it.
230	
231	**Flexibility Indication.** While Tidewater is not willing to make an unqualified representation, Tidewater is willing to provide a qualified representation that would address the Secured Party\'s concern. Specifically, Tidewater could represent that, to its knowledge after reasonable inquiry of its current records, Tidewater has not entered into any other control agreement with respect to the Account as of a specified date. Alternatively, or in addition, Tidewater could represent that it has not \"knowingly\" entered into any other control agreement with respect to the Account.
232	
233	Tidewater could also agree to a forward-looking covenant to notify the Secured Party promptly if Tidewater becomes aware, at any time during the term of the ACA, of any other control agreement or similar arrangement purporting to cover the Account. Such a covenant would provide the Secured Party with ongoing protection without requiring Tidewater to make a backward-looking factual representation that it cannot fully verify.
234	
235	**[X. SECTION 15 --- NOTICES (Section 15.3)]{.underline}**
236	
237	**Summary of Changes**
238	
239	In **Section 15.3**, Tidewater has replaced the same-day compliance standard for entitlement orders and Notices of Exclusive Control with a \"commercially reasonable efforts to act within two (2) Business Days\" standard, measured from the time of Tidewater\'s receipt of a compliant entitlement order or Notice of Exclusive Control. Tidewater has also added safe-harbor language providing that Tidewater shall not be liable for any failure to act within the two-Business-Day period if Tidewater has exercised commercially reasonable efforts to do so, and that no such delay shall constitute a breach of the ACA or give rise to any claim for damages by the Secured Party or the Pledgor.
240	
241	**Tidewater\'s Rationale.** Same-day compliance is operationally infeasible for a national trust company processing entitlement orders through its institutional custody platform. Tidewater\'s order-processing workflow involves multiple sequential steps: receipt and logging of the order, authentication of the submitting party\'s identity and authority, compliance screening (including OFAC sanctions screening, anti-money-laundering review, and applicable embargo checks), operational review and approval by Tidewater\'s Trust Operations team, and execution through Tidewater\'s trade and settlement systems. These steps involve both automated and manual components and cannot reliably be completed within a single business day, particularly for orders received late in the day or involving complex securities transactions (such as cross-border settlements, restricted securities, or orders requiring coordination with sub-custodians or transfer agents).
242	
243	Tidewater\'s Operational Risk Standards (Section 7.2) expressly prohibit Tidewater from committing to same-day processing timelines for third-party-directed transactions where authentication and compliance screening are required. This prohibition exists because an expedited processing commitment creates pressure to bypass or truncate compliance and authentication procedures --- an outcome that is incompatible with Tidewater\'s regulatory obligations and that the OCC has specifically identified as a supervisory concern for national trust companies.
244	
245	The two-Business-Day standard, qualified by a commercially-reasonable-efforts obligation, is consistent with Tidewater\'s processing commitments in the Custody Agreement (Section 4.5) and in the other control agreements currently in effect across Tidewater\'s institutional custody business. This standard reflects a realistic assessment of processing timelines for the types of transactions that are likely to be directed under the ACA, and it has been accepted by other institutional lenders in comparable transactions.
246	
247	The safe-harbor language protects Tidewater from strict-liability claims arising from processing delays that are beyond Tidewater\'s reasonable control, including delays caused by market disruptions, systems outages, unusually high transaction volumes, counterparty delays, or force majeure events. Without safe-harbor protection, the processing-time commitment would function as a guarantee of performance timing --- a guarantee that Tidewater cannot provide given the inherent variability in trade settlement and custody operations.
248	
249	**Flexibility Indication.** Tidewater cannot commit to same-day processing and considers the commercially-reasonable-efforts qualifier and the safe-harbor language essential. These elements of the provision are not subject to negotiation.
250	
251	That said, Tidewater has flexibility on the specific timeframe and could consider a commitment to use commercially reasonable efforts to act within one (1) Business Day following receipt of a compliant entitlement order or Notice of Exclusive Control, rather than two (2) Business Days, provided the commercially-reasonable-efforts qualifier and the safe-harbor provision are retained in full.
252	
253	Tidewater could also discuss the implementation of tiered processing timelines that differentiate by transaction type. For example, Tidewater could commit to a shorter processing window (e.g., one Business Day) for cash-only entitlement orders (which involve fewer settlement and compliance complexities) and a longer window (e.g., two Business Days) for securities-transfer orders that require coordination with settlement systems, sub-custodians, or transfer agents. Such a tiered approach would provide the Secured Party with faster processing where feasible while maintaining realistic timelines for more complex transactions.
254	
255	\\ *\\* \\\*
256	
257	We trust that the foregoing discussion, together with the enclosed redline, provides your team with a clear and complete understanding of Tidewater\'s positions and the rationale underlying each of them. Tidewater is committed to finalizing the ACA on a timeline consistent with the June 2, 2025 initial funding date under the Credit Agreement, and we will make ourselves and Tidewater\'s personnel available as needed to achieve that objective.
258	
259	In the interest of narrowing the open issues efficiently before Whitfield Greer prepares its counter-turn, I would welcome the opportunity to schedule a call between myself and you --- with Mr. Norwood and deal principals from Orion and Halcyon participating as appropriate --- to discuss the markup and identify areas where agreement can be reached promptly. Please let me know your availability during the weeks of May 5 and May 12, and I will coordinate with Mr. Norwood\'s schedule.
260	
261	Please note that Tidewater\'s markup also includes certain conforming and ministerial changes --- including cross-reference updates, section renumbering to reflect deleted provisions, and corrections to defined-term usage --- that are not separately addressed in this letter. These changes are visible in the enclosed redline and should be self-explanatory.
262	
263	We request that any counter-turn redline be transmitted to both of the following:

265	> Sandra M. Fleiss, Esq. Brannock Hale Rivers LLP 750 East Pratt Street, Suite 900 Baltimore, MD 21202

269	> James K. Norwood Senior Vice President & Associate General Counsel Tidewater National Trust Company 100 Light Street, 18th Floor Baltimore, MD 21202
270	>
271	> Email: jnorwood@tidewaterntc.com
272	
273	These addresses correspond to the contact information set forth in Schedule B to the ACA.
274	
275	The enclosed markup constitutes the complete set of changes requested by Tidewater at this stage, subject to Tidewater\'s review of any counter-proposals received from the Secured Party or the Pledgor. Tidewater reserves all rights to propose additional changes in response to counter-proposals.
276	
277	Thank you for your attention to this matter. We look forward to working with you and your team to bring the ACA to execution.
278	
279	Very truly yours,
280	
281	BRANNOCK HALE RIVERS LLP

Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, Securities Intermediary shall credit all such items to the Account as financial assets and shall treat each credit of a financial asset to the Account as giving rise to a \"security entitlement\" in favor of Pledgor, as entitlement holder, in accordance with Section 8-501 of the UCC.

The parties intend that the law of the State of New York shall govern all issues specified in Section 8-110(d) of the UCC with respect to the Account and any security entitlements relating thereto.

93	**[SECTION 2 --- ENTITLEMENT ORDERS]{.underline}**
94	
95	**Section 2.1** *Obligation to Comply with Secured Party\'s Entitlement Orders.* Securities Intermediary hereby agrees that it shall comply with all Entitlement Orders originated by the Secured Party (or by any person designated in writing by the Secured Party as an authorized representative) with respect to the Account, including, without limitation, any Entitlement Order directing the transfer, delivery, sale, redemption, exchange, or other disposition of any Financial Assets credited to the Account, or the disbursement of any cash held therein, **without further consent of the Pledgor** or any other person. Securities Intermediary acknowledges and agrees that its obligation to comply with Entitlement Orders originated by the Secured Party applies at all times, whether or not an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing under the Credit Agreement, and regardless of any other circumstance. The Secured Party shall not be required to provide any certification, statement, evidence of authority, or other documentation in connection with any Entitlement Order, and Securities Intermediary shall be fully protected in relying on and complying with any Entitlement Order that Securities Intermediary reasonably believes to have been originated by the Secured Party or its authorized representative.
96	
97	**Section 2.2** *Pledgor\'s Entitlement Orders Prior to Notice of Exclusive Control.* Until such time as Securities Intermediary receives a Notice of Exclusive Control from the Secured Party in accordance with Section 3, Securities Intermediary shall also comply with Entitlement Orders originated by Pledgor (or by any person designated by Pledgor in accordance with the Custody Agreement) with respect to the Account, subject to and in accordance with the terms of the Custody Agreement and this Agreement. In the event of any conflict between an Entitlement Order originated by the Secured Party and an Entitlement Order originated by Pledgor with respect to the same Financial Assets, Security Entitlements, or cash held in the Account, the Entitlement Order of the Secured Party shall govern and control in all respects, and Securities Intermediary shall comply with the Secured Party\'s Entitlement Order and shall not comply with the conflicting Entitlement Order of Pledgor.
98	
99	**Section 2.3** *Effect of Compliance.* Securities Intermediary shall not be liable to Pledgor or to any other person for complying with any Entitlement Order originated by the Secured Party in accordance with this Agreement, whether or not such Entitlement Order was authorized by Pledgor, and whether or not an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing under the Credit Agreement. Pledgor hereby acknowledges and consents to Securities Intermediary\'s compliance with all Entitlement Orders originated by the Secured Party in accordance with this Section 2 and releases Securities Intermediary from any and all liability arising from or related to such compliance.

101	**[SECTION 3 --- NOTICE OF EXCLUSIVE CONTROL]{.underline}**
102	
103	**Section 3.1** *Delivery and Effectiveness.* The Secured Party may at any time, in its sole and absolute discretion, deliver to Securities Intermediary a Notice of Exclusive Control substantially in the form attached hereto as **Exhibit A**. Upon receipt of a Notice of Exclusive Control by Securities Intermediary, Securities Intermediary shall immediately and without delay cease complying with all Entitlement Orders and all other instructions originated by Pledgor (or by any person acting on behalf of Pledgor) with respect to the Account and shall thereafter comply solely and exclusively with Entitlement Orders and instructions originated by the Secured Party (or by any person designated in writing by the Secured Party as its authorized representative). No officer\'s certificate, evidence of default, legal opinion, court order, or other documentation shall be required to accompany the Notice of Exclusive Control, and Securities Intermediary shall not require, request, or condition its compliance on the delivery of any such documentation. The Notice of Exclusive Control shall become effective immediately upon its receipt by Securities Intermediary, and no cure period, grace period, waiting period, or notice period of any kind shall apply. The parties acknowledge and agree that time is of the essence with respect to Securities Intermediary\'s compliance with a Notice of Exclusive Control.
104	
105	**Section 3.2** *Rescission.* A Notice of Exclusive Control may be rescinded only by a written notice delivered by the Secured Party to Securities Intermediary expressly rescinding such Notice of Exclusive Control. No rescission shall be effective unless signed by an authorized officer or representative of the Secured Party. Upon receipt by Securities Intermediary of a written rescission notice from the Secured Party, Securities Intermediary shall resume complying with Pledgor\'s Entitlement Orders with respect to the Account in accordance with Section 2.2 of this Agreement and the Custody Agreement. Pledgor shall have no right to request, require, or effect the rescission of a Notice of Exclusive Control.
106	
107	**Section 3.3** *No Inquiry by Securities Intermediary.* Securities Intermediary shall not be required to inquire as to, and shall have no obligation or duty to determine or verify, whether an Event of Default has occurred or is continuing under the Credit Agreement, whether the conditions to delivery of a Notice of Exclusive Control under the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document have been satisfied, or whether the Secured Party is otherwise entitled to deliver a Notice of Exclusive Control. Securities Intermediary shall be fully protected in acting in accordance with any Notice of Exclusive Control that Securities Intermediary reasonably believes to have been originated by the Secured Party.
108

110	
111	**Section 4.1** *Subordination.* Securities Intermediary hereby irrevocably subordinates in favor of the Secured Party any and all security interests, liens, encumbrances, claims, charges, and rights of set-off that Securities Intermediary may now have or hereafter acquire in, on, or with respect to the Account, the Financial Assets, the Security Entitlements, and any cash or other property at any time credited thereto or held therein, whether arising under the Custody Agreement, under any other agreement between Securities Intermediary and Pledgor, by operation of law, by contract, or otherwise (collectively, \"Securities Intermediary Liens\"). Such statements shall be provided no less frequently than **weekly**, delivered by electronic transmission or other means acceptable to the Secured Party and Pledgor within two (2) Business Days following the close of each weekly reporting period (with each weekly reporting period ending on Friday, or the preceding Business Day if Friday is not a Business Day). Each statement shall include, at a minimum, the following information: (a) a listing of all Financial Assets held in the Account, identified by issuer, CUSIP or ISIN number (as applicable), quantity, and market value; (b) all cash balances, by currency; (c) a summary of all transactions during the reporting period; and (d) any pending or unsettled transactions as of the close of the reporting period.
120

Securities Intermediary shall issue login credentials, access instructions, and such technical documentation as may be necessary to enable the Secured Party\'s designated personnel to access the online portal within five (5) Business Days following execution of this Agreement. Securities Intermediary\'s liability shall extend to direct damages and shall not be limited to nominal or consequential damages to the extent such damages are foreseeable and arise directly from Securities Intermediary\'s breach.

136

138	
139	**Section 7.1** *Maintenance of Account.* Securities Intermediary shall maintain the Account, and all Financial Assets and Security Entitlements credited thereto, in accordance with the UCC, applicable law, and the terms of this Agreement, throughout the term of this Agreement. Securities Intermediary shall not change the name, designation, or account number of the Account, and shall not merge, consolidate, or combine the Account with any other account, without providing at least thirty (30) days\' prior written notice to the Secured Party and Pledgor. In the event Securities Intermediary proposes to change the account number or designation of the Account, Securities Intermediary shall cooperate with the Secured Party and Pledgor to execute and deliver any amendments, supplements, or replacement agreements as may be necessary to maintain the Secured Party\'s perfected security interest in and control over the Account as so redesignated.
140	
141	**Section 7.2** *No Transfers Without Authorization.* Except as directed by an Entitlement Order from Pledgor (prior to receipt of a Notice of Exclusive Control in accordance with Section 3) or from the Secured Party, Securities Intermediary shall not transfer, redeem, liquidate, sell, exchange, deliver, withdraw, or otherwise dispose of any Financial Assets, Security Entitlements, or cash credited to the Account, and shall not permit any such transfer, redemption, liquidation, sale, exchange, delivery, withdrawal, or disposition. Securities Intermediary shall not release or deliver any Financial Assets or Security Entitlements from the Account to any person or to any other account except pursuant to a valid Entitlement Order in accordance with this Agreement.
142	
143	**Section 7.3** *Distributions and Income.* Prior to the receipt of a Notice of Exclusive Control, all dividends, interest, principal payments, redemption proceeds, and other distributions and income on or with respect to Financial Assets credited to the Account (collectively, \"Distributions\") shall be collected by Securities Intermediary and credited to the Account promptly upon receipt, in accordance with the Custody Agreement and Securities Intermediary\'s customary settlement practices. Following the receipt by Securities Intermediary of a Notice of Exclusive Control, all Distributions shall be held in the Account and shall not be released, disbursed, or otherwise disposed of by Securities Intermediary except pursuant to Entitlement Orders originated by the Secured Party. 146	
147	**Section 8.1** *Pledgor\'s Indemnification of Securities Intermediary.* Pledgor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Securities Intermediary and its officers, directors, employees, agents, and representatives (each, a \"Securities Intermediary Indemnified Party\") from and against any and all claims, liabilities, losses, damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys\' fees and disbursements) arising out of, resulting from, or relating to: (a) any breach by Pledgor of any representation, warranty, covenant, or obligation of Pledgor under this Agreement; (b) any Entitlement Order given by or on behalf of Pledgor with respect to the Account; or (c) Securities Intermediary\'s performance of its duties and obligations under this Agreement in accordance with the terms hereof, including, without limitation, Securities Intermediary\'s compliance with any Entitlement Order originated by the Secured Party or with any Notice of Exclusive Control; in each case, except to the extent that such claim, liability, loss, damage, cost, or expense is directly and proximately caused by Securities Intermediary\'s own failure to exercise ordinary care in the performance of its duties under this Agreement. 148	
149	**Section 8.2** *No Indemnification by Secured Party.* The Secured Party shall have no obligation to indemnify Securities Intermediary or any other person under this Agreement, except to the extent of any loss, damage, cost, or expense directly and proximately caused by the Secured Party\'s own gross negligence or willful misconduct in originating an Entitlement Order or a Notice of Exclusive Control. 150	
151	**Section 8.3** *Securities Intermediary\'s Indemnification of Secured Party.* Securities Intermediary shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Secured Party and its officers, directors, members, managers, employees, agents, and representatives (each, a \"Secured Party Indemnified Party\") from and against any and all claims, liabilities, losses, damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys\' fees and disbursements) to the extent arising out of, resulting from, or relating to Securities Intermediary\'s failure to exercise ordinary care in the performance of its obligations under this Agreement. The indemnification obligations of Securities Intermediary under this Section 8.3 shall survive the termination of this Agreement.

153	**[SECTION 9 --- ADVERSE CLAIMS]{.underline}**
154	
155	**Section 9.1** *Notice of Adverse Claims.* Securities Intermediary shall promptly (and in any event within one (1) Business Day of becoming aware thereof) notify the Secured Party and Pledgor in writing if Securities Intermediary receives notice or otherwise becomes aware of any lien, encumbrance, attachment, garnishment, levy, injunction, restraining order, adverse claim, or other assertion of rights or interests by any person (other than the Secured Party) with respect to the Account or any Financial Assets, Security Entitlements, or cash credited thereto. 156	
157	**Section 9.2** *Compliance with Court Orders.* Securities Intermediary shall not comply with any court order, regulatory directive, writ, injunction, subpoena, summons, or other legal process purporting to attach, garnish, restrain, freeze, sequester, or otherwise encumber or affect the Account or any Financial Assets, Security Entitlements, or cash credited thereto, without first: (a) providing the Secured Party with prompt written notice thereof, including copies of all relevant legal process; and (b) affording the Secured Party a reasonable opportunity, which shall be not less than five (5) Business Days following the Secured Party\'s receipt of such notice (unless a shorter period is required by applicable law, in which case Securities Intermediary shall provide the maximum notice period permitted by applicable law), to contest, quash, or seek a stay or modification of such order, directive, or process. Securities Intermediary shall cooperate with the Secured Party in connection with any such contest or challenge, including by providing such information and documentation as the Secured Party may reasonably request. Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this Section 9.2 shall require Securities Intermediary to violate any applicable law or court order.

162	
163	**Section 10.2** *Termination upon Release.* This Agreement shall terminate automatically, without any further action by any party, upon the receipt by Securities Intermediary of a written confirmation from the Secured Party stating that all Secured Obligations have been indefeasibly paid in full in cash and that all commitments of the Lenders under the Credit Agreement have been permanently and irrevocably terminated. Upon such termination, this Agreement shall be of no further force or effect (except as provided in Section 10.5), the Secured Party shall have no further rights hereunder with respect to the Account, and Securities Intermediary shall comply with Entitlement Orders originated by Pledgor in accordance with the Custody Agreement.
164	
165	**Section 10.3** *No Unilateral Termination by Securities Intermediary.* Securities Intermediary may not resign from its obligations under, or terminate, this Agreement without the prior written consent of the Secured Party. Any purported resignation or termination by Securities Intermediary without such consent shall be void and of no force or effect.
166

brannock-hale-cover-letter.md:45:The conflicting-instruction provision in Section 2.2 protects Tidewater from liability in the event that the Secured Party and the Pledgor issue contradictory entitlement orders simultaneously. Tidewater cannot be placed in the position of choosing between two authorized parties without interpleader-type protection. This is a standard provision in tri-party control agreements and reflects Tidewater\'s obligation to act prudently where it receives conflicting directives from parties to whom it owes duties.
orion-form-aca-initial-draft.md:157:**Section 9.2** *Compliance with Court Orders.* Securities Intermediary shall not comply with any court order, regulatory directive, writ, injunction, subpoena, summons, or other legal process purporting to attach, garnish, restrain, freeze, sequester, or otherwise encumber or affect the Account or any Financial Assets, Security Entitlements, or cash credited thereto, without first: (a) providing the Secured Party with prompt written notice thereof, including copies of all relevant legal process; and (b) affording the Secured Party a reasonable opportunity, which shall be not less than five (5) Business Days following the Secured Party\'s receipt of such notice (unless a shorter period is required by applicable law, in which case Securities Intermediary shall provide the maximum notice period permitted by applicable law), to contest, quash, or seek a stay or modification of such order, directive, or process. Securities Intermediary shall cooperate with the Secured Party in connection with any such contest or challenge, including by providing such information and documentation as the Secured Party may reasonably request. Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this Section 9.2 shall require Securities Intermediary to violate any applicable law or court order.

234	
235	\(c\) the words \"herein,\" \"hereof,\" \"hereto\" and words of similar import shall refer to this Agreement as a whole and not to any particular Section, subsection or clause hereof;
236	
237	\(d\) references to Articles, Sections, Exhibits and Schedules are references to Articles and Sections of, and Exhibits and Schedules to, this Agreement unless otherwise specified;
238

240

246

249	\(j\) in the computation of periods of time from a specified date to a later specified date, the word \"from\" means \"from and including\" and the words \"to\" and \"until\" each mean \"to but excluding\";

252	
253	\(l\) the captions and headings herein are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.

255	**[Section 1.03 --- UCC Terms]{.underline}**
256	
257	All terms defined in the UCC and not otherwise defined herein shall have the meanings assigned to them in the UCC as in effect in the State of New York, including the terms \"control,\" \"entitlement order,\" \"financial asset,\" \"securities account,\" and \"security entitlement.\" To the extent of any inconsistency between the definition of any term herein and the definition of such term in the UCC, the definition set forth herein shall control for purposes of this Agreement; provided that, with respect to perfection, the effect of perfection or non-perfection, and priority of Liens in any Collateral, the meanings assigned under the applicable UCC shall govern to the extent required by law.

285	\(b\) Each Borrowing of Revolving Loans shall be in a minimum principal amount of \$500,000 and in integral multiples of \$100,000 in excess thereof, or such lesser amount as may equal the remaining available Revolving Commitments. Each Borrowing of Term Loans shall be in a minimum principal amount of \$1,000,000 and in integral multiples of \$250,000 in excess thereof. 287	\(c\) Each Borrowing Notice shall be irrevocable after delivery; provided that any Borrowing Notice for a Borrowing on the Closing Date may be conditioned upon the occurrence of the Closing Date.

330	
331	**[Section 3.01 --- Interest Rates]{.underline}**
332	
333	\(a\) Subject to the provisions of this Section 3.01, each Term SOFR Loan shall bear interest on the outstanding principal amount thereof for each Interest Period at a rate per annum equal to Term SOFR for such Interest Period plus the Applicable Margin.
334	
335	\(b\) Subject to the provisions of this Section 3.01, each Base Rate Loan shall bear interest on the outstanding principal amount thereof at a rate per annum equal to the Base Rate plus the Applicable Margin.
336	
337	\(c\) Notwithstanding the foregoing, upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, all overdue amounts hereunder and, at the option of the Administrative Agent acting at the direction of the Required Lenders, all outstanding Loans and other Secured Obligations bearing interest shall bear interest at the applicable rate otherwise in effect plus 2.00% per annum.
338	
339	\(d\) Accrued interest on each Loan shall be payable in arrears on each Interest Payment Date, at maturity, and after maturity on demand.
340	
341	\(e\) Interest shall be computed on the basis of a 360-day year and the actual number of days elapsed, except with respect to Base Rate Loans based on the Prime Rate, which may be calculated on the basis customarily used by the Administrative Agent for such rate.

241	\(f\) provide that the Securities Intermediary subordinates any security interest, lien, or right of set-off it may have in the Pledged Securities Account to the security interest of the Administrative Agent, except as may be agreed by the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion; and
242	
243	\(g\) be governed by the laws of the State of New York.
244	
245	The parties acknowledge and agree that the delivery and continued effectiveness of each Account Control Agreement required by this Section 7.14 is a material inducement to the Lenders\' willingness to extend credit hereunder.
246	
247	**[ARTICLE VIII --- NEGATIVE COVENANTS]{.underline}**
248	
249	Until the Commitments have expired or terminated and the principal of and interest on each Loan and all fees, expenses and other amounts payable under any Loan Document have been paid in full and all Letters of Credit have expired or been terminated and all L/C Disbursements have been reimbursed, the Borrower covenants and agrees that:
250	
251	**[Section 8.01 --- Limitation on Indebtedness]{.underline}**
252	
253	The Borrower shall not create, incur, assume or permit to exist any Indebtedness, except:
254	
255	\(a\) Indebtedness under the Loan Documents;
256	
257	\(b\) trade payables and accrued expenses incurred in the ordinary course of business;
258	
259	\(c\) purchase money Indebtedness and capital lease obligations incurred in the ordinary course of business in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed \$2,500,000 at any time outstanding;
260	
261	\(d\) unsecured intercompany Indebtedness among the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, if any, to the extent not otherwise prohibited hereunder;
262	
263	\(e\) obligations in respect of performance bonds, bid bonds, appeal bonds, surety bonds and similar obligations incurred in the ordinary course of business; and
264	
265	\(f\) other unsecured Indebtedness not exceeding \$1,000,000 in the aggregate at any time outstanding and otherwise reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent.
266	
267	**[Section 8.02 --- Limitation on Liens]{.underline}**
268	
269	The Borrower shall not create, incur, assume or permit to exist any Lien on any of its property or assets, whether now owned or hereafter acquired, including any Collateral and any Pledged Securities Account, except:
270	
271	\(a\) Liens created under the Loan Documents;
272	
273	\(b\) Permitted Liens identified on Schedule 8.02;
274	
275	\(c\) Liens for Taxes, assessments or governmental charges not yet delinquent or that are being contested in good faith by appropriate proceedings and for which adequate reserves have been established in accordance with GAAP;
276	
277	\(d\) statutory Liens of landlords, banks, carriers, warehousemen, mechanics, repairmen, workers and materialmen incurred in the ordinary course of business and not overdue or, if overdue, that are being contested in good faith;
278	
279	\(e\) pledges and deposits made in the ordinary course of business in compliance with workers\' compensation, unemployment insurance and other social security laws or regulations; and
280	
281	\(f\) purchase money Liens securing purchase money Indebtedness or capital leases permitted by Section 8.01(c), provided that such Liens attach only to the property acquired with the proceeds of such Indebtedness and secure only the obligations incurred to finance such acquisition.
282	
283	For the avoidance of doubt, Permitted Liens do not include any lien or right of set-off in favor of a Securities Intermediary that is senior to the Administrative Agent\'s security interest or that would impair the Administrative Agent\'s control over any Pledged Securities Account, unless expressly approved in writing by the Administrative Agent.
284	
285	**[Section 8.03 --- Limitation on Fundamental Changes]{.underline}**
286	
287	The Borrower shall not merge into or consolidate with any other Person, or liquidate or dissolve, or sell, transfer, lease or otherwise dispose of all or substantially all of its assets, except that the Borrower may merge with another Person if (a) the Borrower is the surviving entity, (b) no Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing or would result therefrom, and (c) the Administrative Agent has received prior written notice thereof and such documents as it may reasonably request.
288	
289	**[Section 8.04 --- Limitation on Dispositions]{.underline}**
290	
291	The Borrower shall not sell, transfer, lease, license, assign or otherwise dispose of any property or assets, including any equity interests, except:
292	
293	\(a\) dispositions of inventory or used, obsolete, worn-out or surplus equipment in the ordinary course of business;
294	
295	\(b\) dispositions of assets no longer used or useful in the conduct of its business;
296	
297	\(c\) non-exclusive licenses of intellectual property in the ordinary course of business; and
298	
299	\(d\) other dispositions expressly approved in writing by the Administrative Agent and, if required under Section 12.02, the applicable Lenders.
300	
301	**[Section 8.05 --- Limitation on Investments]{.underline}**
302	
303	The Borrower shall not make, incur, assume or permit to exist any Investment in any Person, except:
304	
305	\(a\) Investments existing on the Closing Date and disclosed to the Administrative Agent;
306	
307	\(b\) cash and Cash Equivalents held in deposit accounts and Securities Accounts subject to the Security Documents as required hereby;
308	
309	\(c\) Investments consisting of accounts receivable arising in the ordinary course of business;
310	
311	\(d\) Investments in Subsidiaries to the extent not prohibited by this Agreement and made for bona fide business purposes; and
312	
313	\(e\) other Investments not exceeding \$1,000,000 in the aggregate at any time outstanding and approved by the Administrative Agent.
314	
315	**[Section 8.06 --- Limitation on Restricted Payments]{.underline}**
316	
317	The Borrower shall not declare or make, or agree to pay or make, directly or indirectly, any Restricted Payment, except that the Borrower may make:
318	
319	\(a\) dividends payable solely in common equity interests;
320	
321	\(b\) repurchases of equity interests from former employees, consultants or directors in an aggregate amount not exceeding \$250,000 in any fiscal year; and
322	
323	\(c\) other Restricted Payments expressly approved in writing by the Administrative Agent and the Required Lenders.
324	
325	**[Section 8.07 --- Limitation on Transactions with Affiliates]{.underline}**
326	
327	The Borrower shall not enter into any transaction of any kind with any Affiliate of the Borrower, whether or not in the ordinary course of business, other than on terms substantially as favorable to the Borrower as would be obtainable in a comparable arm\'s-length transaction with a Person that is not an Affiliate, and other than compensation and benefit arrangements for officers and employees entered into in the ordinary course of business and approved by the board of directors or an appropriate committee thereof.
328	
329	**[Section 8.08 --- Limitation on Modifications to Material Agreements]{.underline}**
330	
331	The Borrower shall not amend, modify, supplement, terminate or waive any provision of the Custody Agreement or any Account Control Agreement without the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent. The Borrower shall not enter into any replacement or successor custody agreement, account agreement or similar arrangement affecting any Pledged Securities Account unless such agreement is in form and substance satisfactory to the Administrative Agent and preserves the Administrative Agent\'s perfected first-priority security interest and control over the applicable Pledged Securities Account.
332	
333	**[ARTICLE IX --- FINANCIAL COVENANTS]{.underline}**
334	
335	Until the Commitments have expired or terminated and the principal of and interest on each Loan and all fees, expenses and other amounts payable under any Loan Document have been paid in full and all Letters of Credit have expired or been terminated and all L/C Disbursements have been reimbursed, the Borrower covenants and agrees that:
336	
337	**[Section 9.01 --- Minimum Liquidity]{.underline}**
338	
339	The Borrower shall not permit unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents of the Borrower, measured as of the last day of each fiscal month, to be less than \$10,000,000 at any time. For purposes of this Section 9.01, unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents shall include cash and marketable securities held in any deposit account or Securities Account of the Borrower that is not subject to any Lien other than Liens in favor of the Administrative Agent under the Security Documents and Permitted Liens that do not impair the Administrative Agent\'s rights.
340	
341	**[Section 9.02 --- Maximum Leverage Ratio]{.underline}**
342	
343	The Borrower shall not permit the ratio of Total Funded Debt to EBITDA, calculated as of the last day of each fiscal quarter for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended, to exceed 3.50 to 1.00. For purposes of this Section 9.02, \"Total Funded Debt\" means all Indebtedness for borrowed money, unreimbursed L/C Disbursements, drawn letters of credit, capital lease obligations and other debt-like obligations of the Borrower, determined in accordance with GAAP and in a manner reasonably acceptable to the Administrative Agent.
344	
345	**[Section 9.03 --- Minimum Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio]{.underline}**
346	
347	The Borrower shall not permit the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio, calculated as of the last day of each fiscal quarter for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended, to be less than 1.25 to 1.00.
348	
349	**[ARTICLE X --- THE ADMINISTRATIVE AGENT]{.underline}**
350	
351	**[Section 10.01 --- Appointment and Authority]{.underline}**
352	
353	Each of the Lenders hereby irrevocably appoints and authorizes Orion Capital Lending, LLC to act on its behalf as the Administrative Agent hereunder and under the other Loan Documents, and authorizes the Administrative Agent to take such actions on its behalf and to exercise such powers as are delegated to the Administrative Agent by the terms hereof or thereof, together with such actions and powers as are reasonably incidental thereto. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, each Lender authorizes the Administrative Agent to execute and deliver the Loan Documents, including any Account Control Agree

8	
9	Neither the Administrative Agent nor any of its affiliates, directors, officers, employees, agents, attorneys or advisors shall be liable for any action taken or not taken by it under or in connection with this Agreement or any other Loan Document, except to the extent resulting from its own gross negligence, bad faith or willful misconduct as determined by a final non-appealable judgment of a court of competent jurisdiction. The Administrative Agent shall not be responsible for or have any duty to ascertain or inquire into (a) any statement, warranty or representation made in or in connection with this Agreement or any other Loan Document, (b) the contents of any certificate, report or other document delivered hereunder, (c) the performance or observance of any of the covenants, agreements or other terms or conditions set forth herein or in any other Loan Document, (d) the validity, enforceability, effectiveness or genuineness of this Agreement, any other Loan Document or any other agreement, instrument or document, or (e) the satisfaction of any condition set forth in Article VII or elsewhere herein, other than to confirm receipt of items expressly required to be delivered to the Administrative Agent.
10	
11	**[Section 10.04 --- Reliance by Agent]{.underline}**
12	
13	The Administrative Agent shall be entitled to rely upon, and shall not incur liability for relying upon, any notice, request, certificate, consent, statement, instrument, document or other writing reasonably believed by it to be genuine and to have been signed, sent or otherwise authenticated by the proper Person. The Administrative Agent also may rely upon any statement made to it orally or by telephone and reasonably believed by it to have been made by the proper Person, and shall not incur liability for relying thereon. The Administrative Agent may consult with legal counsel, independent accountants and other experts selected by it, and shall not be liable for any action taken or not taken by it in accordance with the advice of any such counsel, accountants or experts.
14	
15	**[Section 10.05 --- Resignation and Successor Agent]{.underline}**
16	
17	The Administrative Agent may resign at any time by giving prior written notice thereof to the Lenders and the Borrower. Upon any such resignation, the Required Lenders shall have the right, in consultation with the Borrower so long as no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, to appoint a successor Administrative Agent. If no successor shall have been so appointed and shall have accepted such appointment within thirty (30) days after the retiring Administrative Agent gives notice of its resignation, then the retiring Administrative Agent may, on behalf of the Lenders, appoint a successor Administrative Agent from among the Lenders or an Eligible Assignee. Upon the acceptance of its appointment as Administrative Agent hereunder by a successor, such successor shall succeed to and become vested with all the rights, powers, privileges and duties of the retiring Administrative Agent.
18	
19	**[Section 10.06 --- Collateral Matters]{.underline}**
20	
21	The Administrative Agent is authorized, on behalf of the Secured Parties, to enter into all Security Documents, including each Account Control Agreement, and to take all actions with respect to the Collateral as it deems necessary or advisable in accordance with the Loan Documents. Without limiting the foregoing, the Administrative Agent is authorized, on behalf of the Secured Parties:
22	
23	\(a\) to issue entitlement orders with respect to any Pledged Securities Account;
24	
25	\(b\) to deliver notices of exclusive control, notices of sole control, or other instructions to any Securities Intermediary maintaining any Pledged Securities Account;
26	
27	\(c\) to direct any Securities Intermediary to transfer, redeem, liquidate or otherwise dispose of any financial assets credited to any Pledged Securities Account and to remit proceeds thereof to the Administrative Agent;
28	
29	\(d\) to consent to amendments, waivers or supplements to any Account Control Agreement where permitted under this Agreement;
30	
31	\(e\) to release any Lien granted to or held by the Administrative Agent under any Security Document as expressly permitted by this Agreement or approved by the requisite Lenders; and
32	
33	\(f\) to execute and file any financing statements, continuation statements, assignments, notices and other instruments necessary or desirable to perfect, preserve or enforce the Liens granted under the Security Documents.
34	
35	The Lenders acknowledge that the rights of the Administrative Agent with respect to Pledged Securities Accounts and other Collateral may be exercised by the Administrative Agent in its discretion after the occurrence and during the continuance of an Event of Default, subject to any required direction by the Required Lenders under this Agreement.
36	
37	**[ARTICLE XI --- EVENTS OF DEFAULT AND REMEDIES]{.underline}**
38	
39	**[Section 11.01 --- Events of Default]{.underline}**
40	
41	Each of the following events shall constitute an \"Event of Default\":
42	
43	\(a\) the Borrower shall fail to pay any principal of any Loan when and as the same shall become due and payable, whether at the due date thereof, at a date fixed for prepayment, by acceleration or otherwise;
44	
45	\(b\) the Borrower shall fail to pay any interest on any Loan, any fee or any other amount (other than principal) payable under this Agreement or any other Loan Document within three (3) Business Days after the same shall become due and payable;
46	
47	\(c\) any representation or warranty made or deemed made by or on behalf of the Borrower or any other Loan Party in this Agreement, any other Loan Document or any certificate or other document delivered in connection herewith or therewith shall prove to have been incorrect in any material respect when made or deemed made;
48	
49	\(d\) the Borrower or any other Loan Party shall fail to perform or observe any covenant, agreement or obligation contained in Article VI, and such failure shall continue beyond any expressly applicable cure period set forth therein; provided that no cure period shall apply to any failure to comply with Section 6.09;
50	
51	\(e\) the Borrower or any other Loan Party shall fail to perform or observe any covenant, agreement or obligation contained in Article VIII;
52	
53	\(f\) the Borrower shall fail to perform or observe any covenant contained in Article IX; provided that if the sole breach is of a financial covenant under Article IX, the Borrower may cure such breach within fifteen (15) days after the date of delivery of the Compliance Certificate demonstrating such breach by means of a cash equity contribution to the Borrower in an amount sufficient, when added to unrestricted cash, EBITDA or equity as applicable and to the extent permitted by the Administrative Agent\'s methodology for covenant calculations, to bring the Borrower into compliance;
54	
55	\(g\) the Borrower or any Subsidiary shall default in the payment when due of any principal of or interest on any Indebtedness (other than the Obligations) having an aggregate principal amount in excess of \$2,500,000, or any event or condition shall occur that results in such Indebtedness becoming due prior to its stated maturity, after giving effect to any applicable grace period;
56	
57	\(h\) the Borrower or any material Subsidiary shall commence a voluntary case or other proceeding seeking liquidation, reorganization or other relief with respect to itself or its debts under any bankruptcy, insolvency or other similar law, or seeking the appointment of a receiver, trustee, custodian or similar official for it or any substantial part of its property, or shall consent to any such relief or to the appointment of or taking possession by any such official in an involuntary case or proceeding, or shall make a general assignment for the benefit of creditors, or shall admit in writing its inability to pay its debts generally as they become due; or an involuntary case or other proceeding shall be commenced against the Borrower or any material Subsidiary seeking liquidation, reorganization or other relief with respect to it or its debts under any bankruptcy, insolvency or similar law and such involuntary case or proceeding shall remain undismissed, unstayed or unbonded for sixty (60) consecutive days;
58	
59	\(i\) one or more judgments for the payment of money in an aggregate amount in excess of \$2,500,000 (to the extent not covered by independent third-party insurance as to which the insurer has not denied coverage) shall be rendered against the Borrower or any Subsidiary and the same shall remain undischarged for a period of thirty (30) consecutive days during which execution shall not be effectively stayed, or any action shall be legally taken by a judgment creditor to levy upon assets or properties of the Borrower or such Subsidiary to enforce any such judgment;
60	
61	\(j\) an ERISA Event shall have occurred that, when taken together with all other ERISA Events that have occurred, could reasonably be expected to result in liability of the Borrower or any ERISA Affiliate in an aggregate amount exceeding \$2,500,000 or could reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect;
62	
63	\(k\) a Change of Control shall occur;
64

66	
67	\(m\) any Security Document shall cease to create a valid and perfected first-priority Lien on any material portion of the Collateral, subject only to Permitted Liens, or the Administrative Agent shall cease to have \"control\" within the meaning of Sections 8-106 and 9-106 of the UCC over any Pledged Securities Account;

74	
75	Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any Event of Default, the Administrative Agent may, and at the request of the Required Lenders shall, take any or all of the following actions, in each case subject to applicable law:

78

80	
81	\(c\) require the Borrower to cash collateralize the outstanding Letters of Credit in an amount equal to 103% of the aggregate undrawn amount thereof and all unreimbursed L/C Disbursements;
82	
83	\(d\) exercise any and all rights and remedies available under the Security Documents, the UCC or other applicable law, including foreclosing upon, collecting, taking possession of, selling, assigning, transferring or otherwise realizing upon the Collateral;
84

86

89	\(g\) exercise all other rights and remedies available to the Administrative Agent and the Secured Parties under the Loan Documents and applicable law.

91	All rights and remedies of the Administrative Agent and the Secured Parties are cumulative and not exclusive, and the exercise of one right or remedy shall not preclude the exercise of any other right or remedy.

98	
99	\(b\) second, to the payment in full of accrued and unpaid interest, fees and other amounts (other than principal) constituting Secured Obligations, ratably among the parties entitled thereto in accordance with the amounts of such Secured Obligations then owing to them;
100	
101	\(c\) third, to the payment in full of the outstanding principal amount of the Loans and unreimbursed L/C Disbursements, ratably among the parties entitled thereto in accordance with the amounts of such principal and unreimbursed L/C Disbursements then owing to them;
102	
103	\(d\) fourth, to the payment in full of all other Secured Obligations, including obligations under Secured Hedge Agreements and Secured Cash Management Agreements, ratably among the parties entitled thereto in accordance with the amounts thereof then owing to them; and
104	
105	\(e\) fifth, the surplus, if any, to the Borrower or such other Person as may be lawfully entitled thereto.

139	**[Section 12.02 --- Amendments and Waivers]{.underline}**
140	
141	\(a\) No amendment, modification or waiver of any provision of this Agreement or any other Loan Document, and no consent to any departure by the Borrower therefrom, shall in any event be effective unless the same shall be in writing and signed by the Borrower and the Required Lenders, and acknowledged by the Administrative Agent; provided that:
142	
143	> \(i\) no such amendment, modification or waiver shall, without the written consent of each affected Lender, extend the final maturity of any Loan, postpone any scheduled date of payment of principal, interest or fees payable to such Lender, reduce the principal amount of, or the rate of interest on, any Loan or any fees payable to such Lender (other than waiver of default interest or any mandatory prepayment), or change the pro rata sharing provisions hereof;

154	
155	\(a\) The Borrower shall pay (i) all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket expenses incurred by the Administrative Agent and its Affiliates, including the reasonable and documented fees, charges and disbursements of outside counsel for the Administrative Agent, in connection with the preparation, negotiation, execution, delivery and administration of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents and any amendments, waivers or modifications hereof or thereof, and (ii) all reasonable and documented out-of-pocket expenses incurred by the Administrative Agent, the Issuing Bank or any Lender, including the reasonable and documented fees, charges and disbursements of counsel, in connection with the enforcement or protection of their rights in connection with this Agreement and the other Loan Documents.
156	
157	\(b\) The Borrower shall indemnify the Administrative Agent, each Lender, the Issuing Bank, each Hedge Bank, each Cash Management Bank and each Related Party of any of the foregoing (each, an \"Indemnified Person\") against, and hold each Indemnified Person harmless from, any and all losses, claims, damages, liabilities and related expenses, including reasonable and documented attorneys\' fees and disbursements of one primary outside counsel and, if necessary, one local counsel in each relevant jurisdiction, incurred by or asserted against any Indemnified Person arising out of, in connection with, or as a result of (i) the execution or delivery of this Agreement or any other Loan Document or the performance by the parties thereto of their respective obligations, (ii) any Loan or Letter of Credit or the use of the proceeds therefrom, (iii) any actual or alleged presence or Release of Hazardous Materials on or from any property owned or operated by the Borrower, or any Environmental Liability related in any way to the Borrower, or (iv) any actual or prospective claim, litigation, investigation or proceeding relating to any of the foregoing, whether based on contract, tort or any other theory and regardless of whether any Indemnified Person is a party thereto; provided that such indemnity shall not, as to any Indemnified Person, be available to the extent that such losses, claims, damages, liabilities or related expenses are determined by a final non-appealable judgment of a court of competent jurisdiction to have resulted from the gross negligence, bad faith or willful misconduct of such Indemnified Person.
158	
159	\(c\) The provisions of this Section 12.03 shall survive the termination of this Agreement and the repayment of the Obligations.
160	
161	**[Section 12.04 --- Assignments and Participations]{.underline}**
162

19	This PLEDGE AND SECURITY AGREEMENT (this \"**Agreement**\"), dated as of March 28, 2025, is made by **HALCYON BIOSCIENCES, INC.**, a corporation duly organized and existing under the laws of the State of Delaware (the \"**Grantor**\"), in favor of **ORION CAPITAL LENDING, LLC**, a Delaware limited liability company, in its capacity as administrative agent (in such capacity, together with its successors and assigns in such capacity, the \"**Administrative Agent**\") for the Secured Parties (as defined herein).

23	**WHEREAS**, reference is made to that certain Credit Agreement, dated as of March 28, 2025 (as amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, the \"**Credit Agreement**\"), among Halcyon Biosciences, Inc., a Delaware corporation, as Borrower (the \"**Borrower**\"), the several banks and other financial institutions or entities from time to time parties thereto as lenders (collectively, the \"**Lenders**\" and individually, each a \"**Lender**\"), and Orion Capital Lending, LLC, as Administrative Agent for the Lenders;

27	**WHEREAS**, the execution and delivery of this Agreement by the Grantor is a condition precedent to the initial funding of the credit facilities under the Credit Agreement, as set forth in Section 7.01(b) thereof, and the Grantor has determined that the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement is in the best interests of the Grantor; and

36	
37	As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the meanings specified below:

39	\"**Account Control Agreement**\" means, as defined in the Credit Agreement, each tri-party account control agreement entered into among the Grantor, the Administrative Agent, and the applicable Securities Intermediary with respect to a Pledged Securities Account, in form and substance satisfactory to the Administrative Agent, pursuant to which the Administrative Agent is provided with \"control\" (within the meaning of Sections 8-106 and 9-106 of the UCC) over such Pledged Securities Account. 48	
49	\"**Custody Agreement**\" means that certain Custody Agreement, dated as of February 10, 2023, between the Grantor and Tidewater National Trust Company, as custodian, as such agreement may be amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time in accordance with the terms hereof and of the Credit Agreement.

55	\"**Loan Documents**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement.
56	
57	\"**Notice of Exclusive Control**\" means a written notice delivered by the Administrative Agent to a Securities Intermediary pursuant to an Account Control Agreement, directing such Securities Intermediary to comply exclusively with entitlement orders originated by the Administrative Agent with respect to the applicable Pledged Securities Account, without further consent of the Grantor.
58	
59	\"**Permitted Liens**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement.

62	
63	\"**Secured Obligations**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement and means all Obligations of the Grantor and each other Loan Party under or in connection with the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents, including, without limitation, (a) all principal of and interest on (including interest that would accrue but for the filing of a petition in bankruptcy, whether or not such interest is an allowed claim in such proceeding) the Loans, (b) all fees, commissions, charges, costs, and expenses payable by the Grantor or any other Loan Party under the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document, (c) all reimbursement and indemnification obligations of the Grantor or any other Loan Party under the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document, (d) all obligations of the Grantor or any other Loan Party under any Hedge Agreement with any Hedge Bank, (e) all obligations of the Grantor or any other Loan Party under any Cash Management Agreement with any Cash Management Bank, and (f) all other amounts, whether direct or indirect, absolute or contingent, due or to become due, now existing or hereafter arising, under or in connection with the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document.
64	
65	\"**Secured Parties**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement and means, collectively, the Administrative Agent, the Lenders, each Hedge Bank, each Cash Management Bank, and their respective successors and assigns.

67	\"**Securities Intermediary**\" means, with respect to any Securities Account, the person described in Section 8-102(a)(14) of the UCC who maintains such Securities Account.

69	\"**Security Documents**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in the Credit Agreement.

71	\"**Termination Date**\" has the meaning assigned to such term in Section 8.11 of this Agreement.

Without limiting the foregoing, (a) defined terms may be used in the singular or the plural, and the use of any gender shall include all genders, (b) unless the context otherwise requires, the words \"include,\" \"includes,\" and \"including\" shall be deemed to be followed by the phrase \"without limitation,\" (c) the words \"herein,\" \"hereof,\" \"hereby,\" \"hereunder,\" and words of similar import when used in this Agreement refer to this Agreement as a whole and not to any particular provision hereof, (d) references to Articles, Sections, Schedules, and Exhibits are references to Articles, Sections, Schedules, and Exhibits of this Agreement unless otherwise specified, and (e) references to any agreement, instrument, or other document shall include all amendments, restatements, supplements, and other modifications thereto to the extent not prohibited by the terms hereof or of the Credit Agreement.

92	>
93	> \(d\) **Investment Property.** All investment property of the Grantor, including, without limitation, all securities (whether certificated or uncertificated), securities accounts (including the Pledged Securities Accounts), security entitlements, commodity contracts, and commodity accounts, in each case whether now owned or hereafter acquired;

"""Generate a tracked-changes redline from two .docx files.

Usage:
    python redline.py original.docx revised.docx redlined.docx \
        --author "Reviewer" --date 2026-04-30

Default mode: tries the `redlines` package (PyPI, JSv4) for paragraph-level
diffs, falls back to a manual SequenceMatcher + diff-match-patch
implementation when redlines isn't available.

Output is a .docx with native <w:ins>/<w:del> revision elements that render
in Word's Track Changes pane.
"""
import argparse
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from datetime import date
from difflib import SequenceMatcher
from pathlib import Path

import docx
from lxml import etree


W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
NSMAP = {"w": W}


def _paragraph_texts(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    d = docx.Document(str(path))
    return [p.text for p in d.paragraphs]


def _diff_words(a: str, b: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Return word-level diff ops as (op, text) pairs. op ∈ {'eq', 'ins', 'del'}."""
    try:
        from diff_match_patch import diff_match_patch
        dmp = diff_match_patch()
        diffs = dmp.diff_main(a, b)
        dmp.diff_cleanupSemantic(diffs)
        out = []
        for op, text in diffs:
            if op == 0:
                out.append(("eq", text))
            elif op == 1:
                out.append(("ins", text))
            else:
                out.append(("del", text))
        return out
    except ImportError:
        # Fallback: SequenceMatcher on words
        aw, bw = a.split(" "), b.split(" ")
        sm = SequenceMatcher(None, aw, bw)
        ops = []
        for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes():
            if tag == "equal":
                ops.append(("eq", " ".join(aw[i1:i2]) + " "))
            elif tag == "delete":
                ops.append(("del", " ".join(aw[i1:i2]) + " "))
            elif tag == "insert":
                ops.append(("ins", " ".join(bw[j1:j2]) + " "))
            elif tag == "replace":
                ops.append(("del", " ".join(aw[i1:i2]) + " "))
                ops.append(("ins", " ".join(bw[j1:j2]) + " "))
        return ops


def _make_run(text: str) -> etree.Element:
    r = etree.Element(f"{{{W}}}r")
    t = etree.SubElement(r, f"{{{W}}}t")
    t.set("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space", "preserve")
    t.text = text
    return r


def _make_ins(text: str, rev_id: int, author: str, when: str) -> etree.Element:
    ins = etree.Element(f"{{{W}}}ins")
    ins.set(f"{{{W}}}id", str(rev_id))
    ins.set(f"{{{W}}}author", author)
    ins.set(f"{{{W}}}date", when)
    ins.append(_make_run(text))
    return ins


def _make_del(text: str, rev_id: int, author: str, when: str) -> etree.Element:
    d = etree.Element(f"{{{W}}}del")
    d.set(f"{{{W}}}id", str(rev_id))
    d.set(f"{{{W}}}author", author)
    d.set(f"{{{W}}}date", when)
    r = etree.SubElement(d, f"{{{W}}}r")
    t = etree.SubElement(r, f"{{{W}}}delText")
    t.set("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space", "preserve")
    t.text = text
    return r.getparent()


def redline(original: Path, revised: Path, output: Path, author: str, when: str):
    # Use the original as the base document so styles/headers/footers are preserved.
    # Replace its body paragraphs with revision-marked versions.
    orig_paras = _paragraph_texts(original)
    rev_paras = _paragraph_texts(revised)

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as workdir:
        wd = Path(workdir)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(original) as z:
            z.extractall(wd)
        doc_xml = wd / "word" / "document.xml"
        tree = etree.parse(str(doc_xml))
        root = tree.getroot()
        body = root.find(f"{{{W}}}body")
        if body is None:
            print("ERROR: no body in document.xml", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

        # Find sectPr to preserve at end
        sect_pr = body.find(f"{{{W}}}sectPr")
        # Remove all existing paragraphs (we rebuild)
        for p in list(body):
            if p.tag != f"{{{W}}}sectPr":
                body.remove(p)

        sm = SequenceMatcher(None, orig_paras, rev_paras)
        rev_id = 1
        for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes():
            if tag == "equal":
                for text in orig_paras[i1:i2]:
                    p = etree.SubElement(body, f"{{{W}}}p")
                    if text:
                        p.append(_make_run(text))
            elif tag == "delete":
                for text in orig_paras[i1:i2]:
                    p = etree.SubElement(body, f"{{{W}}}p")
                    if text:
                        p.append(_make_del(text, rev_id, author, when))
                        rev_id += 1
            elif tag == "insert":
                for text in rev_paras[j1:j2]:
                    p = etree.SubElement(body, f"{{{W}}}p")
                    if text:
                        p.append(_make_ins(text, rev_id, author, when))
                        rev_id += 1
            elif tag == "replace":
                # Word-level diff for replaced paragraphs (assume 1:1 for now)
                pairs = list(zip(orig_paras[i1:i2], rev_paras[j1:j2]))
                # Handle unequal lengths by padding
                if len(orig_paras[i1:i2]) > len(rev_paras[j1:j2]):
                    # Extra deletions
                    pairs += [(t, "") for t in orig_paras[i1 + len(pairs):i2]]
                elif len(rev_paras[j1:j2]) > len(orig_paras[i1:i2]):
                    pairs += [("", t) for t in rev_paras[j1 + len(pairs):j2]]
                for a, b in pairs:
                    p = etree.SubElement(body, f"{{{W}}}p")
                    for op, txt in _diff_words(a, b):
                        if not txt:
                            continue
                        if op == "eq":
                            p.append(_make_run(txt))
                        elif op == "ins":
                            p.append(_make_ins(txt, rev_id, author, when))
                            rev_id += 1
                        elif op == "del":
                            p.append(_make_del(txt, rev_id, author, when))
                            rev_id += 1

        # Restore sectPr at end
        if sect_pr is not None:
            body.remove(sect_pr)
            body.append(sect_pr)

        tree.write(str(doc_xml), xml_declaration=True, encoding="UTF-8", standalone=True)

        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(output, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
            for p in sorted(wd.rglob("*")):
                if p.is_file():
                    zout.write(p, p.relative_to(wd).as_posix())

    print(f"OK: wrote {output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("original")
    p.add_argument("revised")
    p.add_argument("output")
    p.add_argument("--author", default="Reviewer")
    p.add_argument("--date", default=date.today().isoformat() + "T00:00:00Z")
    args = p.parse_args()
    redline(Path(args.original), Path(args.revised), Path(args.output), args.author, args.date)
"""Validate a .docx for delivery.

Checks ZIP integrity, XML well-formedness for every part, [Content_Types].xml
presence, and relationship consistency (no dangling rIds). Does NOT do XSD
schema validation in v1 — defer until ECMA-376 XSDs are vendored fresh from
ECMA-International.

Usage: python validate.py file.docx
Exit 0 = valid; non-zero = errors printed to stderr.
"""
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from lxml import etree


def validate(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    errors = []

    if not path.exists():
        return [f"File not found: {path}"]
    if not zipfile.is_zipfile(path):

125:**Section 5.4** *Electronic Access.* Securities Intermediary shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide the Secured Party (through up to two (2) individuals designated by it in writing) with read-only access to information regarding the Account through the Tidewater ClientView Portal (as defined in the Custody Agreement) or any successor client reporting platform, subject to Securities Intermediary\'s standard third-party access terms and information security requirements, as soon as practicable and in any event within ninety (90) days following the date of this Agreement. 149:**Section 8.2** *Limited Indemnification by Secured Party.* The Secured Party shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless each Securities Intermediary Indemnified Party from and against any and all claims, liabilities, losses, damages, costs, and expenses (including reasonable and documented attorneys\' fees and disbursements) arising directly out of Securities Intermediary\'s compliance, in accordance with this Agreement, with any Entitlement Order or Notice of Exclusive Control originated by the Secured Party, but only to the extent that (a) the same are not paid or reimbursed by Pledgor within thirty (30) days after Securities Intermediary\'s written demand therefor under Section 8.1, and (b) the same are not caused by Securities Intermediary\'s own negligence, bad faith, or willful misconduct (determined in accordance with Section 6.1). The obligations of the Secured Party under this Section 8.2 are several and not joint and several with the obligations of Pledgor under Section 8.1, and in no event shall the Secured Party be liable under this Section 8.2 for any claim, liability, loss, damage, cost, or expense arising from any Entitlement Order or instruction originated by Pledgor, from the Custody Agreement, or from any fees, expenses, or Custodian Obligations owing to Securities Intermediary. The obligations of the Secured Party under this Section 8.2 shall survive the termination of this Agreement.
165:**Section 10.3** *Resignation by Securities Intermediary.* Securities Intermediary may resign from its obligations under, and terminate, this Agreement, with or without cause, upon not less than ninety (90) calendar days\' prior written notice to the Secured Party and the Pledgor (consistent with Section 12.3 of the Custody Agreement), or, if Securities Intermediary\'s continued performance hereunder would violate applicable law, regulation, or Sanctions (as defined in the Credit Agreement) or a written directive of a Governmental Authority having jurisdiction over Securities Intermediary, upon such shorter notice (but not less than thirty (30) calendar days, unless a shorter period is required by such law, regulation, Sanctions, or directive) as is consistent with such requirement, which notice shall describe the basis for such shorter notice in reasonable detail to the extent legally permitted. Such resignation and termination shall become effective on the later of (a) the expiration of the applicable notice period and (b) the date on which all Financial Assets and cash credited to the Account (other than amounts retained in accordance with the last sentence of this Section 10.3) have been transferred to a successor securities intermediary designated by the Secured Party (in consultation with Pledgor) that has entered into a control agreement with the Secured Party and Pledgor in form and substance satisfactory to the Secured Party (such date, the \"SI Termination Date\"). The Secured Party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to designate such successor during the notice period, and Pledgor shall cooperate in such designation. sub("The framework Orion is working within")
body("Several of Orion`s positions below are not commercial preferences but requirements of the Loan Documents to which Orion, Halcyon Biosciences, Inc. (“Halcyon” or the “Pledgor”) and the Lenders are already bound, and which must be satisfied before the June 2, 2025 initial funding. In particular, Section 7.14 of the Credit Agreement requires that the ACA (a) be in form and substance satisfactory to the Administrative Agent, (c) provide “control” within the meaning of UCC Sections 8-106 and 9-106, (d) require Tidewater to comply with Orion`s entitlement orders “without further consent of the Borrower or any other person,” (e) contain Tidewater`s acknowledgment that it has not entered into, and will not enter into, any agreement to comply with entitlement orders of any other person, (f) subordinate Tidewater`s liens and set-off rights except as the Administrative Agent may agree, and (g) be governed by New York law. In addition, Section 6.09 of the Credit Agreement makes maintenance of control “of the essence” with no cure period, Section 11.01(m) makes any loss of control an immediate Event of Default, and Section 8.02 and Schedule 8.02 provide that no securities intermediary lien or set-off right that is senior to Orion`s security interest is a Permitted Lien unless Orion expressly consents in writing.
